<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <title>UT / CEM — Texas Microgrid Lab (All-in-One)</title>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1" />

  <!-- Leaflet CSS -->
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css"/>
  <!-- noUiSlider CSS -->
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/noUiSlider/15.7.0/nouislider.min.css"/>

  <style>
    :root{
      --ut-burnt: #BF5700;
      --bg-muted: #f5f5f6;
      --map-ui-bg: rgba(255,255,255,0.96);
      --ui-border: rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
      --text: #222;
      --tx345: #BF5700;
      --txlow: #2b7aa1;
      --gas: #ff8a33;
      --coal: #7f7f7f;
      --wind: #16a3b5;
      --solar: #f2c94c;
      --nuclear: #8a5fb0;
      --dc: #2ca02c;
    }

    html,body { height:100%; margin:0; padding:0; font-family: Inter, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; background:var(--bg-muted); color:var(--text); }
    #map { height:100vh; width:100vw; }

    /* Legend - bottom-left */
    .legend-box {
      position: absolute;
      left: 14px;
      bottom: 14px;
      z-index: 1000;
      background: var(--map-ui-bg);
      padding: 12px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
      border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
      width: 260px;
    }
    .legend-title { font-weight:700; color:var(--ut-burnt); margin-bottom:8px; }
    .legend-row { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; margin:6px 0; font-size:13px; }
    .legend-swatch { width:22px; height:12px; border-radius:3px; border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06); }
    .legend-circle { width:14px; height:14px; border-radius:50%; display:inline-block; margin-right:6px; vertical-align:middle; }

    /* Controls (bottom-right) */
    .controls-box {
      position: absolute;
      right: 14px;
      bottom: 14px;
      z-index: 1000;
      background: var(--map-ui-bg);
      padding: 10px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
      border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
      width: 160px;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .controls-box button {
      display:block;
      width:100%;
      margin:6px 0;
      padding:8px 10px;
      border-radius:8px;
      border:1px solid var(--ui-border);
      background:white;
      cursor:pointer;
      font-weight:600;
      color:var(--text);
    }
    .controls-box button.primary { background:var(--ut-burnt); color:#fff; border:none; }

    /* Slider - top center */
    .slider-wrap {
      position: absolute;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      top: 12px;
      z-index: 1000;
      background: var(--map-ui-bg);
      padding: 8px 12px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
      box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
      display:flex;
      gap:12px;
      align-items:center;
    }
    #slider { width:380px; max-width:60vw; }
    .slider-label { font-weight:700; color:var(--text); min-width:54px; }

    /* Ensure layer control placed top-left without overlap */
    .leaflet-control-layers { margin-top: 18px; margin-left: 8px; }

    .credits { position:absolute; left:14px; top:14px; z-index:1000; font-size:12px; color:#444; background:transparent; padding:4px 6px; border-radius:6px; }
    .leaflet-popup-content-wrapper { font-size:13px; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div id="map"></div>

  <!-- small credits (top-left) -->
  <div class="credits">Sample demo • UT CEM</div>

  <!-- Slider (top center) -->
  <div class="slider-wrap" aria-hidden="false">
    <div class="slider-label">Year</div>
    <div id="slider"></div>
    <div id="sliderValue" style="min-width:56px; text-align:center; font-weight:700;">2025</div>
  </div>

  <!-- Legend (bottom-left) -->
  <div class="legend-box" id="legend">
    <div class="legend-title">UT / CEM — Texas Grid Legend</div>
    <div class="legend-row"><div class="legend-swatch" style="background:var(--tx345)"></div><div>Transmission — 345 kV</div></div>
    <div class="legend-row"><div class="legend-swatch" style="background:var(--txlow)"></div><div>Transmission — 138/230 kV</div></div>
    <div class="legend-row"><div class="legend-circle" style="background:var(--gas)"></div><div>Gas Plant</div></div>
    <div class="legend-row"><div class="legend-circle" style="background:var(--coal)"></div><div>Coal Plant</div></div>
    <div class="legend-row"><div class="legend-circle" style="background:var(--wind)"></div><div>Wind Farm</div></div>
    <div class="legend-row"><div class="legend-circle" style="background:var(--solar)"></div><div>Solar Farm</div></div>
    <div class="legend-row"><div class="legend-circle" style="background:var(--nuclear)"></div><div>Nuclear Plant</div></div>
    <div class="legend-row"><div class="legend-swatch" style="background:var(--dc); width:14px; height:14px; border-radius:3px;"></div><div>Data Center (major)</div></div>
  </div>

  <!-- Controls (bottom-right) -->
  <div class="controls-box" role="region" aria-label="Map controls">
    <button id="playPauseBtn" class="primary">⏯ Play Flows</button>
    <button id="resetViewBtn">🔄 Reset View</button>
  </div>

  <!-- Leaflet & noUiSlider -->
  <script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
  <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/noUiSlider/15.7.0/nouislider.min.js"></script>

  <script>
  /************************************************************************
   * Single-file interactive map (UT / CEM)
   * - Layer control at top-left
   * - Legend bottom-left
   * - Controls bottom-right
   * - Slider top-center
   * - Embedded sample GeoJSON
   ************************************************************************/

  /* ---------------------------
     Embedded GeoJSON (sample data)
     --------------------------- */
  const TX_TRANSMISSION = {
    "type":"FeatureCollection","features":[
      {"type":"Feature","properties":{"voltage":"345","owner":"ONCOR"},"geometry":{"type":"LineString","coordinates":[[-96.7969,32.7763],[-97.7431,30.2672]]}},
      {"type":"Feature","properties":{"voltage":"345","owner":"AEP"},"geometry":{"type":"LineString","coordinates":[[-97.7431,30.2672],[-95.3698,29.7604]]}},
      {"type":"Feature","properties":{"voltage":"138","owner":"CPS"},"geometry":{"type":"LineString","coordinates":[[-98.4936,29.4241],[-97.7431,30.2672]]}}
    ]
  };

  const TX_PLANTS = {
    "type":"FeatureCollection","features":[
      {"type":"Feature","properties":{"name":"South Texas Nuclear","fuel":"Nuclear","capacity":2500,"commission_year":1988},"geometry":{"type":"Point","coordinates":[-96.064,28.797]}},
      {"type":"Feature","properties":{"name":"Panda Temple I","fuel":"Gas","capacity":758,"commission_year":2011},"geometry":{"type":"Point","coordinates":[-97.3428,31.1171]}},
      {"type":"Feature","properties":{"name":"Roscoe Wind Farm","fuel":"Wind","capacity":781,"commission_year":2009},"geometry":{"type":"Point","coordinates":[-100.476,32.304]}},
      {"type":"Feature","properties":{"name":"Large Solar Farm","fuel":"Solar","capacity":400,"commission_year":2018},"geometry":{"type":"Point","coordinates":[-99.193,27.506]}},
      {"type":"Feature","properties":{"name":"Austin Energy Decker","fuel":"Gas","capacity":900,"commission_year":2000},"geometry":{"type":"Point","coordinates":[-97.598,30.279]}}
    ]
  };

  const TX_DATACENTERS = {
    "type":"FeatureCollection","features":[
      {"type":"Feature","properties":{"name":"Google Midlothian DC","load":250,"commission_year":2016},"geometry":{"type":"Point","coordinates":[-96.994,32.484]}},
      {"type":"Feature","properties":{"name":"Meta Temple DC","load":200,"commission_year":2017},"geometry":{"type":"Point","coordinates":[-97.346,31.15]}},
      {"type":"Feature","properties":{"name":"Microsoft San Antonio DC","load":180,"commission_year":2019},"geometry":{"type":"Point","coordinates":[-98.395,29.457]}}
    ]
  };

  /* ---------------------------
     Init map
     --------------------------- */
  const map = L.map('map', { zoomControl: true }).setView([31.0, -99.0], 6);
  L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', { maxZoom: 18, attribution: '© OpenStreetMap contributors' }).addTo(map);

  const css = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
  const styles = {
    tx345: css.getPropertyValue('--tx345').trim() || '#BF5700',
    txlow: css.getPropertyValue('--txlow').trim() || '#2b7aa1',
    gas: css.getPropertyValue('--gas').trim() || '#ff8a33',
    coal: css.getPropertyValue('--coal').trim() || '#7f7f7f',
    wind: css.getPropertyValue('--wind').trim() || '#16a3b5',
    solar: css.getPropertyValue('--solar').trim() || '#f2c94c',
    nuclear: css.getPropertyValue('--nuclear').trim() || '#8a5fb0',
    dc: css.getPropertyValue('--dc').trim() || '#2ca02c'
  };

  /* ---------------------------
     Layers & styling
     --------------------------- */
  const transmissionLayer = L.geoJSON(TX_TRANSMISSION, {
    style: f => ({ color: (f.properties && f.properties.voltage === "345") ? styles.tx345 : styles.txlow, weight: (f.properties && f.properties.voltage === "345") ? 3.4 : 2.2, opacity: 0.95 })
  });

  function plantColor(fuel){
    if(!fuel) return styles.gas;
    switch(fuel.toLowerCase()){
      case 'wind': return styles.wind;
      case 'solar': return styles.solar;
      case 'nuclear': return styles.nuclear;
      case 'coal': return styles.coal;
      case 'gas': return styles.gas;
      default: return styles.gas;
    }
  }

  const plantLayerOrig = L.geoJSON(TX_PLANTS, {
    pointToLayer: (feature, latlng) => L.circleMarker(latlng, { radius: 7, fillOpacity: 0.95, color: plantColor(feature.properties.fuel), weight: 1 }),
    onEachFeature: (feature, layer) => {
      const p = feature.properties || {};
      layer.bindPopup(`<b>${p.name || 'Plant'}</b><br>Fuel: ${p.fuel || 'N/A'}<br>Capacity: ${p.capacity || 'N/A'} MW<br>Year: ${p.commission_year || 'N/A'}`);
    }
  });

  const datacenterLayerOrig = L.geoJSON(TX_DATACENTERS, {
    pointToLayer: (feature, latlng) => L.circleMarker(latlng, { radius: 9, fillOpacity: 0.95, color: styles.dc, weight: 1.2 }),
    onEachFeature: (feature, layer) => {
      const p = feature.properties || {};
      layer.bindPopup(`<b>${p.name || 'Data Center'}</b><br>Load: ${p.load || 'N/A'} MW<br>Year: ${p.commission_year || 'N/A'}`);
    }
  });

  // Add initial layers
  transmissionLayer.addTo(map);
  plantLayerOrig.addTo(map);
  datacenterLayerOrig.addTo(map);

  // Layer control (top-left)
  const overlays = { "Transmission Lines": transmissionLayer, "Power Plants": plantLayerOrig, "Data Centers": datacenterLayerOrig };
  L.control.layers(null, overlays, { collapsed: false, position: 'topleft' }).addTo(map);

  /* ---------------------------
     Flow particles
     --------------------------- */
  function interpolatePoint(coords, t){
    if(!coords || coords.length === 0) return null;
    if(t <= 0) return coords[0];
    if(t >= 1) return coords[coords.length-1];
    const segLens = []; let total = 0;
    for(let i=1;i<coords.length;i++){
      const dx = coords[i][0] - coords[i-1][0];
      const dy = coords[i][1] - coords[i-1][1];
      const L = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
      segLens.push(L); total += L;
    }
    let target = t * total, cum = 0;
    for(let i=0;i<segLens.length;i++){
      if(cum + segLens[i] >= target){
        const r = (target - cum) / segLens[i];
        const a = coords[i], b = coords[i+1];
        return [ a[0] + (b[0]-a[0]) * r, a[1] + (b[1]-a[1]) * r ];
      }
      cum += segLens[i];
    }
    return coords[coords.length-1];
  }

  const flows = [];
  TX_TRANSMISSION.features.forEach((f) => {
    if(!f.geometry || f.geometry.type !== 'LineString') return;
    const coords = f.geometry.coordinates;
    const dx = coords[coords.length-1][0] - coords[0][0];
    const dy = coords[coords.length-1][1] - coords[0][1];
    const baseCount = Math.max(1, Math.round(Math.hypot(dx,dy) * 4));
    for(let p=0;p<baseCount;p++){
      const start = p / baseCount;
      const speed = 0.0009 + Math.random() * 0.0012;
      const col = (f.properties && f.properties.voltage === "345") ? styles.tx345 : styles.txlow;
      const marker = L.circleMarker([coords[0][1], coords[0][0]], { radius: 3.2, fillOpacity: 0.95, color: col, weight: 0.7 }).addTo(map);
      flows.push({ coords, progress: start, speed, marker });
    }
  });

  let animRunning = false, lastTime = null;
  function animateFlows(timestamp){
    if(!animRunning){ lastTime = null; return; }
    if(!lastTime) lastTime = timestamp;
    const dt = timestamp - lastTime; lastTime = timestamp;
    const factor = dt / 16.67;
    flows.forEach(f => {
      f.progress += f.speed * factor;
      if(f.progress > 1) f.progress -= Math.floor(f.progress);
      const pt = interpolatePoint(f.coords, f.progress);
      if(pt) f.marker.setLatLng([pt[1], pt[0]]);
    });
    requestAnimationFrame(animateFlows);
  }

  document.getElementById('playPauseBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
    animRunning = !animRunning;
    document.getElementById('playPauseBtn').textContent = animRunning ? '⏸ Pause Flows' : '⏯ Play Flows';
    if(animRunning) requestAnimationFrame(animateFlows);
    else lastTime = null;
  });

  document.getElementById('resetViewBtn').addEventListener('click', () => map.setView([31.0, -99.0], 6));

  /* ---------------------------
     Time slider: filter by commission_year (cumulative)
     --------------------------- */
  const years = [];
  TX_PLANTS.features.forEach(f => { if(f.properties && f.properties.commission_year) years.push(f.properties.commission_year); });
  TX_DATACENTERS.features.forEach(f => { if(f.properties && f.properties.commission_year) years.push(f.properties.commission_year); });
  const minYear = Math.min(...years, 1990);
  const maxYear = Math.max(...years, new Date().getFullYear());

  const slider = document.getElementById('slider');
  const sliderValue = document.getElementById('sliderValue');

  noUiSlider.create(slider, {
    start: [maxYear],
    connect: true,
    step: 1,
    range: { min: minYear, max: maxYear },
    tooltips: true,
    format: { to: v => Math.round(v), from: v => Number(v) }
  });

  let plantLayerFiltered = null, datacenterLayerFiltered = null;

  function updateYearFilter(year){
    sliderValue.textContent = year;
    const pf = { type: 'FeatureCollection', features: TX_PLANTS.features.filter(f => (f.properties && (f.properties.commission_year || 9999) <= year)) };
    const df = { type: 'FeatureCollection', features: TX_DATACENTERS.features.filter(f => (f.properties && (f.properties.commission_year || 9999) <= year)) };

    if(plantLayerFiltered) map.removeLayer(plantLayerFiltered);
    if(datacenterLayerFiltered) map.removeLayer(datacenterLayerFiltered);

    plantLayerFiltered = L.geoJSON(pf, {
      pointToLayer: (feature, latlng) => L.circleMarker(latlng, { radius: 7, fillOpacity: 0.95, color: plantColor(feature.properties.fuel), weight: 1 }),
      onEachFeature: (feature, layer) => {
        const p = feature.properties || {};
        layer.bindPopup(`<b>${p.name || 'Plant'}</b><br>Fuel: ${p.fuel || 'N/A'}<br>Capacity: ${p.capacity || 'N/A'} MW<br>Year: ${p.commission_year || 'N/A'}`);
      }
    }).addTo(map);

    datacenterLayerFiltered = L.geoJSON(df, {
      pointToLayer: (feature, latlng) => L.circleMarker(latlng, { radius: 9, fillOpacity: 0.95, color: styles.dc, weight: 1.2 }),
      onEachFeature: (feature, layer) => {
        const p = feature.properties || {};
        layer.bindPopup(`<b>${p.name || 'Data Center'}</b><br>Load: ${p.load || 'N/A'} MW<br>Year: ${p.commission_year || 'N/A'}`);
      }
    }).addTo(map);

    // refresh layer control to reference the filtered plant/dc layers
    const existing = document.getElementsByClassName('leaflet-control-layers');
    Array.from(existing).forEach(e => e.remove());
    const curOverlays = { "Transmission Lines": transmissionLayer, "Power Plants": plantLayerFiltered, "Data Centers": datacenterLayerFiltered };
    L.control.layers(null, curOverlays, { collapsed: false, position: 'topleft' }).addTo(map);
  }

  slider.noUiSlider.on('update', (values, handle) => updateYearFilter(parseInt(values[handle])));
  slider.noUiSlider.set(maxYear);

  // helper for plant marker colors
  function plantColor(fuel){
    if(!fuel) return styles.gas;
    switch((fuel||'').toLowerCase()){
      case 'wind': return styles.wind;
      case 'solar': return styles.solar;
      case 'nuclear': return styles.nuclear;
      case 'coal': return styles.coal;
      case 'gas': return styles.gas;
      default: return styles.gas;
    }
  }

  // Fit map to content
  const bounds = L.featureGroup([transmissionLayer, plantLayerOrig, datacenterLayerOrig]).getBounds();
  if(bounds.isValid()) map.fitBounds(bounds.pad(0.12));

  </script>
</body>
</html>

  </div>

  <!-- Leaflet & noUiSlider -->
  <script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
  <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/noUiSlider/15.7.0/nouislider.min.js"></script>

  <script>
  /************************************************************************
   * Single-file interactive map (UT / CEM) — Option A ERCOT lines embedded
   * Fixed Data Center toggle by using persistent LayerGroups and updating
   * layer contents rather than replacing layer instances.
   ************************************************************************/

  /* ---------------------------
     Embedded Option A: simplified ERCOT transmission GeoJSON
     (Representative subset for demo; replace with authoritative file if desired)
     --------------------------- */
  const TX_ERCOT_TRANSMISSION = {
    "type": "FeatureCollection",
    "features": [
      // major corridors linking Dallas - Austin - Houston - San Antonio - Corpus Christi
      {"type":"Feature","properties":{"voltage":"345","owner":"ONCOR"},"geometry":{"type":"LineString","coordinates":[[-96.8,32.78],[-97.14,32.2],[-97.74,30.267]]}},
      {"type":"Feature","properties":{"voltage":"345","owner":"AEP"},"geometry":{"type":"LineString","coordinates":[[-97.74,30.267],[-96.1,30.0],[-95.37,29.76]]}},
      {"type":"Feature","properties":{"voltage":"345","owner":"CPS"},"geometry":{"type":"LineString","coordinates":[[-98.49,29.42],[-97.7431,30.2672]]}},
      {"type":"Feature","properties":{"voltage":"230","owner":"Oncor"},"geometry":{"type":"LineString","coordinates":[[-100.48,32.30],[-98.0,31.0],[-97.74,30.27]]}},
      {"type":"Feature","properties":{"voltage":"345","owner":"ERCOT"},"geometry":{"type":"LineString","coordinates":[[-95.37,29.76],[-94.80,29.80],[-94.0,30.0]]}},
      {"type":"Feature","properties":{"voltage":"138","owner":"AEP"},"geometry":{"type":"LineString","coordinates":[[-97.3,31.1],[-96.1,30.0]]}},
      {"type":"Feature","properties":{"voltage":"345","owner":"Oncor"},"geometry":{"type":"LineString","coordinates":[[-96.99,32.48],[-96.4,31.9],[-97.34,31.15]]}},
      {"type":"Feature","properties":{"voltage":"230","owner":"ERCOT"},"geometry":{"type":"LineString","coordinates":[[-99.19,27.50],[-98.40,29.45]]}},
      {"type":"Feature","properties":{"voltage":"138","owner":"AEP"},"geometry":{"type":"LineString","coordinates":[[-100.48,32.30],[-99.5,31.6],[-98.5,31.0]]}},
      {"type":"Feature","properties":{"voltage":"345","owner":"ERCOT"},"geometry":{"type":"LineString","coordinates":[[-97.74,30.27],[-97.598,30.279]]}},
      // add a few more short segments to give network look
      {"type":"Feature","properties":{"voltage":"138","owner":"Local"},"geometry":{"type":"LineString","coordinates":[[-96.8,32.78],[-96.99,32.48]]}},
      {"type":"Feature","properties":{"voltage":"230","owner":"Local"},"geometry":{"type":"LineString","coordinates":[[-95.37,29.76],[-96.06,28.80]]}}
    ]
  };

  /* ---------------------------
     Sample plants and datacenters (same as before, include commission_year)
     --------------------------- */
  const TX_PLANTS = {
    "type":"FeatureCollection","features":[
      {"type":"Feature","properties":{"name":"South Texas Nuclear","fuel":"Nuclear","capacity":2500,"commission_year":1988},"geometry":{"type":"Point","coordinates":[-96.064,28.797]}},
      {"type":"Feature","properties":{"name":"Panda Temple I","fuel":"Gas","capacity":758,"commission_year":2011},"geometry":{"type":"Point","coordinates":[-97.3428,31.1171]}},
      {"type":"Feature","properties":{"name":"Roscoe Wind Farm","fuel":"Wind","capacity":781,"commission_year":2009},"geometry":{"type":"Point","coordinates":[-100.476,32.304]}},
      {"type":"Feature","properties":{"name":"Large Solar Farm","fuel":"Solar","capacity":400,"commission_year":2018},"geometry":{"type":"Point","coordinates":[-99.193,27.506]}},
      {"type":"Feature","properties":{"name":"Austin Energy Decker","fuel":"Gas","capacity":900,"commission_year":2000},"geometry":{"type":"Point","coordinates":[-97.598,30.279]}}
    ]
  };

  const TX_DATACENTERS = {
    "type":"FeatureCollection","features":[
      {"type":"Feature","properties":{"name":"Google Midlothian DC","load":250,"commission_year":2016},"geometry":{"type":"Point","coordinates":[-96.994,32.484]}},
      {"type":"Feature","properties":{"name":"Meta Temple DC","load":200,"commission_year":2017},"geometry":{"type":"Point","coordinates":[-97.346,31.15]}},
      {"type":"Feature","properties":{"name":"Microsoft San Antonio DC","load":180,"commission_year":2019},"geometry":{"type":"Point","coordinates":[-98.395,29.457]}}
    ]
  };

  /* ---------------------------
     Initialize map
     --------------------------- */
  const map = L.map('map', { zoomControl: true }).setView([31.0, -99.0], 6);
  L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', { maxZoom: 18, attribution: '© OpenStreetMap contributors' }).addTo(map);

  const css = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
  const styles = {
    tx345: css.getPropertyValue('--tx345').trim() || '#BF5700',
    txlow: css.getPropertyValue('--txlow').trim() || '#2b7aa1',
    gas: css.getPropertyValue('--gas').trim() || '#ff8a33',
    coal: css.getPropertyValue('--coal').trim() || '#7f7f7f',
    wind: css.getPropertyValue('--wind').trim() || '#16a3b5',
    solar: css.getPropertyValue('--solar').trim() || '#f2c94c',
    nuclear: css.getPropertyValue('--nuclear').trim() || '#8a5fb0',
    dc: css.getPropertyValue('--dc').trim() || '#2ca02c'
  };

  /* ---------------------------
     Persistent LayerGroups (fixes toggle behavior)
     - We create empty layer groups and add them to the map / control.
     - When the slider updates we clear the groups and add new GeoJSON layers inside them.
     --------------------------- */
  const transmissionGroup = L.layerGroup().addTo(map);
  const plantsGroup = L.layerGroup().addTo(map);
  const dcsGroup = L.layerGroup().addTo(map);

  // helper: add transmission features into transmissionGroup (static)
  function populateTransmission() {
    transmissionGroup.clearLayers();
    const tx = L.geoJSON(TX_ERCOT_TRANSMISSION, {
      style: f => ({ color: (f.properties && f.properties.voltage === "345") ? styles.tx345 : styles.txlow, weight: (f.properties && f.properties.voltage === "345") ? 3.4 : 2.2, opacity: 0.95 })
    });
    transmissionGroup.addLayer(tx);
  }

  // helper: add plants into plantsGroup given a year threshold (cumulative)
  function populatePlants(year) {
    plantsGroup.clearLayers();
    const filtered = {
      type: 'FeatureCollection',
      features: TX_PLANTS.features.filter(f => (f.properties && (f.properties.commission_year || 9999) <= year))
    };
    const pfl = L.geoJSON(filtered, {
      pointToLayer: (feature, latlng) => L.circleMarker(latlng, { radius: 7, fillOpacity: 0.95, color: plantColor(feature.properties.fuel), weight: 1 }),
      onEachFeature: (feature, layer) => {
        const p = feature.properties || {};
        layer.bindPopup(`<b>${p.name || 'Plant'}</b><br>Fuel: ${p.fuel || 'N/A'}<br>Capacity: ${p.capacity || 'N/A'} MW<br>Year: ${p.commission_year || 'N/A'}`);
      }
    });
    plantsGroup.addLayer(pfl);
  }

  // helper: add datacenters into dcsGroup by year threshold
  function populateDCs(year) {
    dcsGroup.clearLayers();
    const filtered = {
      type: 'FeatureCollection',
      features: TX_DATACENTERS.features.filter(f => (f.properties && (f.properties.commission_year || 9999) <= year))
    };
    const dcl = L.geoJSON(filtered, {
      pointToLayer: (feature, latlng) => L.circleMarker(latlng, { radius: 9, fillOpacity: 0.95, color: styles.dc, weight: 1.2 }),
      onEachFeature: (feature, layer) => {
        const p = feature.properties || {};
        layer.bindPopup(`<b>${p.name || 'Data Center'}</b><br>Load: ${p.load || 'N/A'} MW<br>Year: ${p.commission_year || 'N/A'}`);
      }
    });
    dcsGroup.addLayer(dcl);
  }

  // initial populate (max year)
  const allYears = [].concat(
    TX_PLANTS.features.map(f => f.properties.commission_year || 9999),
    TX_DATACENTERS.features.map(f => f.properties.commission_year || 9999)
  );
  const minYear = Math.min(...allYears, 1990);
  const maxYear = Math.max(...allYears, new Date().getFullYear());

  populateTransmission();
  populatePlants(maxYear);
  populateDCs(maxYear);

  // Layer control using the persistent groups (these remain the same objects => toggles work)
  const overlays = {
    "Transmission Lines": transmissionGroup,
    "Power Plants": plantsGroup,
    "Data Centers": dcsGroup
  };
  L.control.layers(null, overlays, { collapsed: false, position: 'topleft' }).addTo(map);

  /* ---------------------------
     Flow particles (use transmissionGroup features)
     - We'll read the transmissionGroup's inner GeoJSON layer to create particles.
     - Keep particle markers in a separate group for easy management.
     --------------------------- */
  const flowMarkersGroup = L.layerGroup().addTo(map); // particles
  const flows = []; // internal flow objects

  function resetFlows() {
    // remove markers and objects
    flowMarkersGroup.clearLayers();
    flows.length = 0;

    // find geojson layer inside transmissionGroup
    transmissionGroup.eachLayer(layer => {
      if (layer.feature && layer.feature.geometry && layer.feature.geometry.type === 'LineString') {
        // For each LineString feature, create particles
        const coords = layer.feature.geometry.coordinates;
        // create a handful of particles per segment to show movement
        const dx = coords[coords.length-1][0] - coords[0][0];
        const dy = coords[coords.length-1][1] - coords[0][1];
        const baseCount = Math.max(1, Math.round(Math.hypot(dx, dy) * 4));
        for (let p = 0; p < baseCount; p++) {
          const start = p / baseCount;
          const speed = 0.0008 + Math.random() * 0.0012;
          const col = (layer.feature.properties && layer.feature.properties.voltage === "345") ? styles.tx345 : styles.txlow;
          const marker = L.circleMarker([coords[0][1], coords[0][0]], { radius: 3.0, fillOpacity: 0.95, color: col, weight: 0.7 });
          marker.addTo(flowMarkersGroup);
          flows.push({ coords, progress: start, speed, marker });
        }
      } else if (layer.getLayers) {
        // If layer is a FeatureGroup / GeoJSON group, check its child layers (some implementations)
        layer.eachLayer(child => {
          if (child.feature && child.feature.geometry && child.feature.geometry.type === 'LineString') {
            const coords = child.feature.geometry.coordinates;
            const dx = coords[coords.length-1][0] - coords[0][0];
            const dy = coords[coords.length-1][1] - coords[0][1];
            const baseCount = Math.max(1, Math.round(Math.hypot(dx, dy) * 4));
            for (let p = 0; p < baseCount; p++) {
              const start = p / baseCount;
              const speed = 0.0008 + Math.random() * 0.0012;
              const col = (child.feature.properties && child.feature.properties.voltage === "345") ? styles.tx345 : styles.txlow;
              const marker = L.circleMarker([coords[0][1], coords[0][0]], { radius: 3.0, fillOpacity: 0.95, color: col, weight: 0.7 });
              marker.addTo(flowMarkersGroup);
              flows.push({ coords, progress: start, speed, marker });
            }
          }
        });
      }
    });
  }

  function interpolatePoint(coords, t) {
    if (!coords || coords.length === 0) return null;
    if (t <= 0) return coords[0];
    if (t >= 1) return coords[coords.length - 1];
    const segLens = []; let total = 0;
    for (let i = 1; i < coords.length; i++) {
      const dx = coords[i][0] - coords[i - 1][0];
      const dy = coords[i][1] - coords[i - 1][1];
      const L = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
      segLens.push(L); total += L;
    }
    let target = t * total, cum = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < segLens.length; i++) {
      if (cum + segLens[i] >= target) {
        const r = (target - cum) / segLens[i];
        const a = coords[i], b = coords[i + 1];
        return [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * r, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * r];
      }
      cum += segLens[i];
    }
    return coords[coords.length - 1];
  }

  // animation
  let animRunning = false, lastTime = null;
  function animateFlows(timestamp) {
    if (!animRunning) { lastTime = null; return; }
    if (!lastTime) lastTime = timestamp;
    const dt = timestamp - lastTime; lastTime = timestamp;
    const factor = dt / 16.67;
    flows.forEach(f => {
      f.progress += f.speed * factor;
      if (f.progress > 1) f.progress -= Math.floor(f.progress);
      const pt = interpolatePoint(f.coords, f.progress);
      if (pt) f.marker.setLatLng([pt[1], pt[0]]);
    });
    requestAnimationFrame(animateFlows);
  }

  document.getElementById('playPauseBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
    animRunning = !animRunning;
    document.getElementById('playPauseBtn').textContent = animRunning ? '⏸ Pause Flows' : '⏯ Play Flows';
    if (animRunning) requestAnimationFrame(animateFlows);
    else lastTime = null;
  });

  document.getElementById('resetViewBtn').addEventListener('click', () => map.setView([31.0, -99.0], 6));

  // create flows initially
  resetFlows();

  /* ---------------------------
     Time slider: update plantsGroup and dcsGroup in-place
     --------------------------- */
  const slider = document.getElementById('slider');
  const sliderValue = document.getElementById('sliderValue');

  noUiSlider.create(slider, {
    start: [maxYear],
    connect: true,
    step: 1,
    range: { min: minYear, max: maxYear },
    tooltips: true,
    format: { to: v => Math.round(v), from: v => Number(v) }
  });

  // initial populate already done; ensure the control shows these groups
  // whenever the slider changes, update the groups (clearLayers + add)
  slider.noUiSlider.on('update', (values, handle) => {
    const y = parseInt(values[handle]);
    sliderValue.textContent = y;
    populatePlants(y);
    populateDCs(y);
  });

  // update at start to reflect default slider
  slider.noUiSlider.set(maxYear);

  /* ---------------------------
     Helpers
     --------------------------- */
  function plantColor(fuel) {
    if (!fuel) return styles.gas;
    switch ((fuel || '').toLowerCase()) {
      case 'wind': return styles.wind;
      case 'solar': return styles.solar;
      case 'nuclear': return styles.nuclear;
      case 'coal': return styles.coal;
      case 'gas': return styles.gas;
      default: return styles.gas;
    }
  }

  /* ---------------------------
     Fit to content
     --------------------------- */
  const bounds = L.featureGroup([transmissionGroup, plantsGroup, dcsGroup]).getBounds();
  if (bounds.isValid()) map.fitBounds(bounds.pad(0.12));

  </script>
</body>
</html>

.leaflet-control-layers{ margin-top:76px; }

/* responsive tweaks */
@media (max-width:700px){
  .header-title{font-size:13px;}
  .header-sub{font-size:11px;}
  .header-bar{left:6px;right:6px;height:44px;padding:6px 10px;}
  #map{top:58px;}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- thin transparent header (Option B) with embedded SVG logo -->
<div class="header-bar" role="banner" aria-label="CEM header">
  <!-- simple museum-style SVG logo (keeps file self-contained) -->
  <svg class="logo-svg" viewBox="0 0 200 48" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" aria-hidden="true">
    <g fill="none" fill-rule="evenodd">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="48" height="48" rx="6" fill="#fff" stroke="#BF5700" stroke-width="2"/>
      <path d="M8 36 L16 14 L24 36 Z" fill="#BF5700"/>
      <circle cx="36" cy="12" r="4" fill="#2f3b40"/>
      <!-- small textual hint -->
      <text x="56" y="19" font-family="Georgia, serif" font-size="14" fill="#BF5700">The University of Texas at Austin</text>
    </g>
  </svg>

  <div class="header-text" role="heading" aria-level="1">
    <div class="header-title">Center for Electromechanics — Cockrell School of Engineering</div>
    <div class="header-sub">Texas Electrical Grid — CEM Microgrid Laboratory</div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- map -->
<div id="map" role="application" aria-label="Interactive Texas grid map"></div>

<!-- legend (clean: no heading) -->
<div class="legend" aria-hidden="false">
  <div class="row"><div class="sw" style="background:var(--tx345)"></div><div>345 kV</div></div>
  <div class="row"><div class="sw" style="background:var(--tx138)"></div><div>138 / 230 kV</div></div>
  <div class="row"><div class="dot" style="background:var(--gas)"></div><div>Gas Plant</div></div>
  <div class="row"><div class="dot" style="background:var(--coal)"></div><div>Coal Plant</div></div>
  <div class="row"><div class="dot" style="background:var(--wind)"></div><div>Wind Farm</div></div>
  <div class="row"><div class="dot" style="background:var(--solar)"></div><div>Solar Farm</div></div>
  <div class="row"><div class="dot" style="background:var(--nuclear)"></div><div>Nuclear Plant</div></div>
  <div class="row"><div class="dot" style="background:var(--dc)"></div><div>Data Center</div></div>
</div>

<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
<script>
/* --- Read CSS variables so JS uses exact palette --- */
const css = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
const COLORS = {
  tx345: css.getPropertyValue('--tx345').trim() || '#BF5700',
  tx138: css.getPropertyValue('--tx138').trim() || '#2b7aa1',
  gas: css.getPropertyValue('--gas').trim() || '#ff8a33',
  coal: css.getPropertyValue('--coal').trim() || '#7f7f7f',
  wind: css.getPropertyValue('--wind').trim() || '#16a3b5',
  solar: css.getPropertyValue('--solar').trim() || '#f2c94c',
  nuclear: css.getPropertyValue('--nuclear').trim() || '#8a5fb0',
  dc: css.getPropertyValue('--dc').trim() || '#2ca02c'
};

/* --- initialize map (map top already accounts for header via CSS top offset) --- */
const map = L.map('map', { zoomControl: true }).setView([31.2, -98.5], 7);
L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', { maxZoom: 18, attribution: '© OpenStreetMap' }).addTo(map);

/* --- Example: inline simplified ERCOT-style GeoJSON (Option A) --- */
/* NOTE: replace this block with your real GeoJSON later if you want */
const TX_ERCOT = {
  "type":"FeatureCollection",
  "features":[
    {"type":"Feature","properties":{"voltage":"345"},"geometry":{"type":"LineString","coordinates":[[-97.75,30.27],[-96.0,30.0],[-95.37,29.76]]}},
    {"type":"Feature","properties":{"voltage":"345"},"geometry":{"type":"LineString","coordinates":[[-96.99,32.48],[-97.34,31.15],[-96.06,28.80]]}},
    {"type":"Feature","properties":{"voltage":"138"},"geometry":{"type":"LineString","coordinates":[[-100.47,32.30],[-98.5,31.0],[-97.74,30.27]]}}
  ]
};

/* --- GeoJSON layers for transmission (styled by voltage) --- */
const transmissionLayer = L.geoJSON(TX_ERCOT, {
  style: feature => {
    const v = feature.properties && feature.properties.voltage;
    return {
      color: (v && String(v).includes('345')) ? COLORS.tx345 : COLORS.tx138,
      weight: (v && String(v).includes('345')) ? 4.0 : 3.0,
      opacity: 0.95
    };
  }
});

/* --- plants and datacenters sample features (include commission_year if desired) --- */
const PLANTS = {
  "type":"FeatureCollection","features":[
    {"type":"Feature","properties":{"name":"South Texas Nuclear","fuel":"Nuclear","year":1988},"geometry":{"type":"Point","coordinates":[-96.064,28.797]}},
    {"type":"Feature","properties":{"name":"Panda Temple I","fuel":"Gas","year":2011},"geometry":{"type":"Point","coordinates":[-97.3428,31.1171]}},
    {"type":"Feature","properties":{"name":"Roscoe Wind Farm","fuel":"Wind","year":2009},"geometry":{"type":"Point","coordinates":[-100.476,32.304]}}
  ]
};

const DATACENTERS = {
  "type":"FeatureCollection","features":[
    {"type":"Feature","properties":{"name":"Google Midlothian DC","load":250,"year":2016},"geometry":{"type":"Point","coordinates":[-96.994,32.484]}},
    {"type":"Feature","properties":{"name":"Meta Temple DC","load":200,"year":2017},"geometry":{"type":"Point","coordinates":[-97.346,31.15]}}
  ]
};

/* --- helper to return color by fuel --- */
function colorByFuel(fuel){
  if(!fuel) return COLORS.gas;
  switch(fuel.toLowerCase()){
    case 'wind': return COLORS.wind;
    case 'solar': return COLORS.solar;
    case 'nuclear': return COLORS.nuclear;
    case 'coal': return COLORS.coal;
    case 'gas': return COLORS.gas;
    default: return COLORS.gas;
  }
}

/* --- create persistent LayerGroups (so toggles always work) --- */
const txGroup = L.layerGroup().addTo(map);
const plantsGroup = L.layerGroup().addTo(map);
const dcsGroup = L.layerGroup().addTo(map);

/* populate groups */
function populateTransmission(){
  txGroup.clearLayers();
  txGroup.addLayer(transmissionLayer);
}
function populatePlants(){
  plantsGroup.clearLayers();
  const g = L.geoJSON(PLANTS, {
    pointToLayer: (f,latlng) => L.circleMarker(latlng,{ radius:7, fillColor: colorByFuel(f.properties.fuel), color: colorByFuel(f.properties.fuel), weight:1, fillOpacity:0.95 }),
    onEachFeature: (f,layer) => layer.bindPopup(`<b>${f.properties.name}</b><br>Fuel: ${f.properties.fuel}<br>Year: ${f.properties.year}`)
  });
  plantsGroup.addLayer(g);
}
function populateDCs(){
  dcsGroup.clearLayers();
  const g = L.geoJSON(DATACENTERS, {
    pointToLayer: (f,latlng) => L.circleMarker(latlng,{ radius:8, fillColor: COLORS.dc, color: COLORS.dc, weight:1, fillOpacity:0.95 }),
    onEachFeature: (f,layer) => layer.bindPopup(`<b>${f.properties.name}</b><br>Load: ${f.properties.load || 'N/A'} MW<br>Year: ${f.properties.year || 'N/A'}`)
  });
  dcsGroup.addLayer(g);
}

/* initial populate */
populateTransmission();
populatePlants();
populateDCs();

/* layer control (uses persistent groups) */
L.control.layers(null, {
  "Transmission Lines": txGroup,
  "Power Plants": plantsGroup,
  "Data Centers": dcsGroup
}, { collapsed: false, position: 'topleft' }).addTo(map);

/* add default visibility */
txGroup.addTo(map);
plantsGroup.addTo(map);
dcsGroup.addTo(map);

/* fit to content */
const bounds = L.featureGroup([transmissionLayer, L.geoJSON(PLANTS), L.geoJSON(DATACENTERS)]).getBounds();
if(bounds.isValid()) map.fitBounds(bounds.pad(0.12));

</script>
</body>
</html>
